question: When the ingested-declared-grammar applicability guard is implemented as REAL shipped code in src/spider/kernel.py -- SpiderKernel.ingest_declaration adopting an externally supplied declaration only when the module-level certify_declaration accepts it against a frozen audited negative bank -- does it (a) preserve safe+complete resolution under a SOUND declaration at coverage above the shipped 0.6750, (b) refuse a training-consistent OVER-WIDE declaration that the parent training-consistency gate adopts (the BP-DECL-OVERWIDE regime, 201 false accepts), and (c) how far does the soundness guarantee extend, i.e. what bounded closed-world trust boundary must the shipped kernel enforce when declaration soundness is not certifiable in the general case?
hypothesis: A closed-world certificate (adopt iff the declaration is a valid regex that accepts every training positive AND rejects every value of a frozen audited negative bank) shipped as real code will: (i) under R-SOUND (each family's true declared grammar) hold zero false accepts, zero out-of-grammar HTTP executions and zero refusal-semantics violations at coverage 1.0, a strict safe-coverage gain over shipped 0.6750; (ii) under R-OVERWIDE (^<prefix>.*$, training-consistent but unsound) REFUSE the declaration and preserve the shipped support (zero false accepts), whereas C-TRAINING-GATE adopts it and inherits >= 1 (expected 201) false accepts; (iii) under R-EVASION (a certificate-passing declaration whose over-accept is withheld from the audited bank) STILL false-accept, proving the guarantee is closed-world; therefore the shipped product boundary is an audited allowlist plus UNKNOWN-first abstention for uncertified declarations. The treatment is expected to become EXECUTABLE on every IN item under R-SOUND (failure of that is a design/liveness failure, not a scientific negative).
falsifier: The shipped-certificate treatment is FALSIFIED if it is unsafe where it must be safe: any of M-CERT-SOUND-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT, M-CERT-SOUND-HTTP-ON-OUT, M-CERT-SOUND-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT, M-CERT-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT, M-CERT-OVERWIDE-HTTP-ON-OUT or M-CERT-OVERWIDE-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT is > 0. The safe-coverage-gain claim is weakened to MIXED if M-CERT-SOUND-COVERAGE < 1.0. Separately, failure of any control/validity gate (V8_FREEZE_BINDING, M-CARRIER-PRE, M-INSTALL-POST, M-REGRESSION, PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT, PC-EXACT-REPLAY, B-LITERAL-KERNEL, M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY, PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND, PC-CERT-REFUSES-OVERWIDE, PC-CERT-REFUSES-UNDER, PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN, PC-UNSAFE-RAW, B-SHIPPED, B-DECLARED-FULL, NC-REJECT-ALL, PC-DISCRIMINATION, BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS) is MEASUREMENT_INVALID/BLOCKED, never a negative. BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS must fire (certificate admits R-EVASION and the arm false-accepts); if it does not, the boundary probe is non-adversarial and the packet is MEASUREMENT_INVALID rather than evidence of general soundness.

baselines.description: Induced conservative single-observation-length supports, no widening; the frozen safety floor. Expected M-B-SHIPPED-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT=0 and M-B-SHIPPED-COVERAGE=0.6750 (81/120, 39 false rejects across the bank). Same value/logic as the parent's frozen EXPECTED_SHIPPED and source-backstopped by the M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY gate.
baselines.role: safe-but-incomplete floor; the coverage baseline the treatment must strictly exceed without false-accept regression

baselines.description: Raw declared grammar per family under R-SOUND with no guard; the safe+complete support ceiling. Expected FA=0 and coverage 1.0. A comparator showing the ceiling is attainable, not an adopted shipped change.
baselines.role: ceiling comparator / range of possible coverage

baselines.description: The parent declared_guard_support rule (adopt iff every training value fullmatches the declaration, else keep shipped) reproduced verbatim as comparator. Under R-OVERWIDE it must adopt and over-accept (expected M-GATE-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT=201, reproducing the recorded BP-DECL-OVERWIDE boundary). Under R-UNDER it must refuse and fall back to shipped.
baselines.role: the incumbent guard the shipped certificate must strictly dominate on the audited over-wide class

baselines.description: Unconditional adoption of the regime declaration with no guard (ablation). Under R-OVERWIDE it must over-accept (expected 201), proving the unsoundness is intrinsic to the declaration and not introduced by any arm.

PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND.expected_behavior: certify_declaration accepts R-SOUND for all seven families (status CERTIFIED).
PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND.role: certificate is not a reject-everything trivial detector

PC-CERT-REFUSES-OVERWIDE.expected_behavior: certify_declaration refuses R-OVERWIDE for all seven families (status REFUSED).
PC-CERT-REFUSES-OVERWIDE.role: certificate is sensitive to the audited over-wide class; mandatory for the discriminating claim

PC-CERT-REFUSES-UNDER.expected_behavior: certify_declaration refuses R-UNDER for all seven families (it rejects a training positive).
PC-CERT-REFUSES-UNDER.role: certificate is not a rubber stamp; too-narrow declarations are refused

PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN.expected_behavior: on certificate refusal SpiderKernel.ingest_declaration leaves verification_rule['parameter_supports'][slot] byte-equal to the shipped inferred support and records declaration_certificate.status == 'REFUSED'.
PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN.role: refusal semantics: UNKNOWN/abstention is preserved, no unsafe inheritance

PC-UNSAFE-RAW.role: safety oracle is not blind; the FALSIFIES branch is live

PC-DISCRIMINATION.expected_behavior: M-CERT-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT == 0 while M-GATE-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT >= 1 on the same bank.
PC-DISCRIMINATION.role: the treatment strictly dominates the incumbent guard

BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS.expected_behavior: certify_declaration ADMITS R-EVASION for all seven families AND M-CERT-EVASION-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT >= 1 (expected 7).
BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS.role: boundary probe proving the closed-world limitation; required to fire

PC-EXACT-REPLAY.expected_behavior: all 61 training ids re-resolve EXECUTABLE on the installed package (61/61).

null_control.role: null floor; a detector that cannot be null is meaningless
null_control.expected_behavior: Empty registry: nothing is accepted and no HTTP is issued. Expected accept_count == 0 and http_total == 0.

decision_rule.primary_metric: M-CERT-SOUND-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT (T-CERT-GUARD under R-SOUND: count of OUT-labelled bank items whose resolve() status == EXECUTABLE); co-primary M-CERT-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT, M-CERT-SOUND-HTTP-ON-OUT, M-CERT-OVERWIDE-HTTP-ON-OUT, M-CERT-SOUND-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT, M-CERT-OVERWIDE-REFUSAL-EXECUTED-COUNT, M-CERT-SOUND-COVERAGE.

gates.validity_gate: ALL of V8_FREEZE_BINDING, M-CARRIER-PRE, M-INSTALL-POST, M-REGRESSION, PC-DETERMINISM-REPEAT, PC-EXACT-REPLAY, B-LITERAL-KERNEL, M-SUPPORT-IDENTITY, B-SHIPPED (FA==0), B-DECLARED-FULL (FA==0 AND coverage==1.0), NC-REJECT-ALL (accept==0 AND http_total==0) must PASS; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE.
gates.sensitivity_gate: PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND (all CERTIFIED) AND PC-CERT-REFUSES-OVERWIDE (all REFUSED) AND PC-CERT-REFUSES-UNDER (all REFUSED) AND PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN (all preserved) AND PC-UNSAFE-RAW (FA>=1) AND PC-DISCRIMINATION (cert FA==0 AND gate FA>=1); otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
gates.boundary_gate: BP-EVASION-CERT-PASS: certificate admits R-EVASION for all families AND M-CERT-EVASION-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT >= 1; otherwise status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (non-adversarial boundary probe, not evidence of general soundness).

SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_UNSAFE.definition: T-CERT-GUARD under R-SOUND or R-OVERWIDE has false_accept_count > 0 OR http_on_out_label > 0 OR refusal_executed_count > 0.
SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_UNSAFE.meaning: the shipped certificate either adopts an over-wide declaration or fails to abstain; no declaration-ingestion widening is licensed.

SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE.definition: all gates PASS AND M-CERT-SOUND-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT==0 AND M-CERT-SOUND-COVERAGE==1.0 AND M-CERT-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT==0 AND M-GATE-OVERWIDE-FALSE-ACCEPT-COUNT>=1.
SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_SAFE_AND_COMPLETE.meaning: the real shipped certificate safely widens to full coverage on sound declarations and refuses the audited over-wide declaration the incumbent gate adopts; soundness is closed-world (BP-EVASION FA>=1).

SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE.definition: all gates PASS, no safety violation, but M-CERT-SOUND-COVERAGE < 1.0.
SHIPPED_CERTIFICATE_SAFE_BUT_INCOMPLETE.meaning: the certificate is safe but rejects some sound declaration; the safe-coverage gain is partial.

MEASUREMENT_INVALID.definition: any gate above is not PASS.
MEASUREMENT_INVALID.meaning: instrument/binding/control failure; resumable from the frozen packet, never a negative result.

product_consequence_positive: If SUPPORTS: ship SpiderKernel.ingest_declaration + certify_declaration in src/spider/kernel.py. External agents (or a mechanism registry) can then supply declared grammars that raise safe coverage from 0.6750 to 1.0 on the frozen bank, while training-consistent over-wide declarations are refused and the carrier abstains (UNKNOWN) rather than executing out-of-grammar targets. This closes the largest named open safety boundary on the promoted carrier (B1) and is a precondition for the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT arm to consume externally supplied mechanisms. The documented closed-world trust boundary (audited negative bank + UNKNOWN-first abstention) becomes the product contract for declaration ingestion.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES: the shipped certificate cannot separate the sound declaration from the audited over-wide declaration (or is unsafe under R-SOUND), so the product must NOT ingest external declarations through this mechanism at all; keep the conservative carrier, disable declaration ingestion, and record declaration soundness as an unmet product gate. If MIXED: ship the certificate only where it abstains safely, and keep the conservative boundary on rejected families. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID: no product change; retry from the frozen packet. In all non-SUPPORTS branches the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT arm must not consume external declarations.

expected_information_gain: HIGH. Directly resolves both open unknowns carried from EXP-PRODUCT-38201227093: (i) whether the declared-grammar guard still holds as REAL shipped source code under a regression gate, and (ii) what certification step establishes declaration soundness, or -- since a general proof is unavailable -- what bounded closed-world trust boundary the shipped kernel must enforce. It produces a decisive product answer (ship the audited-certificate guard with UNKNOWN-first abstention, or disable declaration ingestion) and either licenses or blocks the flagship C-LLM-INHERIT arm's consumption of external mechanisms. It is not a repeat: it installs new code and adds a certification step the parent gate lacked.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: The outcome mapping is total and every branch is concretely reachable by the frozen decision function on the frozen instrument. SUPPORTS is the predicted branch and was reproduced by the DESIGN sandboxed probe (R-SOUND T-CERT-GUARD FA=0 cov=1.0; R-OVERWIDE T-CERT FA=0 vs C-TRAINING-GATE FA=201; R-EVASION FA=7). FALSIFIES is reachable in the identical decision expression: A-RAW-DECL under R-OVERWIDE yields FA=201 (and if the certificate silently adopted the over-wide declaration, T-CERT R-OVERWIDE would yield the same positive count), so the negative branch is not vacuous. MIXED is reachable by a certificate that accepts some but not all sound declarations (coverage < 1.0 with FA=0). MEASUREMENT_INVALID is reachable via substituted carrier, frozen-block/artifact hash mismatch, regression failure, support drift, or a failing control (e.g. a certificate that rejected the sound declaration fails PC-CERT-ADMITS-SOUND). No branch is empty or arithmetically impossible: coverage in [0,1], false-accept counts in [0,404], and every gate has a concrete failure mode.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is real shipped code and is exercised on the installed/materialized package. The DESIGN induction probe reproduced, for all seven families, a single-slot parameterized mechanism at confidence 0.9 >= 0.8 with support == EXPECTED_SHIPPED, and after calling the real SpiderKernel.ingest_declaration with the sound declaration the certificate arm resolved all 120 IN items EXECUTABLE (coverage 1.0) with zero false rejects and issued 120 loopback HTTP requests, so the treatment structurally binds and executes. On refusal (R-OVERWIDE/R-UNDER) the same code path is exercised and preserves the shipped support (PC-INGEST-ABSTAIN). A structurally dead treatment would be caught by PC-EXACT-REPLAY and by a T-CERT R-SOUND coverage below 1.0 (MIXED) or by MEASUREMENT_INVALID, never silently reported as a negative. The treatment bytes are frozen by POST_SHA256 and the install gate.
